أختزل (form VIII)
# أَخْتَزِلُ (ʔaḵtazilu) /ʔax.ta.zi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# أُخْتَزَلُ (ʔuḵtazalu) /ʔux.ta.za.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# أَخْتَزِلَ (ʔaḵtazila) /ʔax.ta.zi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# أُخْتَزَلَ (ʔuḵtazala) /ʔux.ta.za
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
